title: Command injection in the documentserver-flush-cache.sh maintenance helper in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server)…
description: A command injection vulnerability exists in the documentserver-flush-cache.sh maintenance helper script in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) version 9.4.0-129. A local attacker with ds user privileges can exploit this flaw by supplying a crafted --hash argument that is improperly validated and interpolated into a GNU sed expression. This allows execution of arbitrary commands as root due to the sed e flag and the sudoers policy permitting ds to run the helper as root without a password and with unrestricted arguments.
